standard_prerequisites.name: Exactness checked after applying Hom
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the criterion by which exactness of the Hom-into-(-, \mathcal{F}) sequences for all \mathcal{F} yields exactness of the original sequence.

core_obligations: Apply \Hom_\mathcal{O}(-, \mathcal{F}) to the presented sequence and obtain the exact sequence 0 \to \mathcal{F}(U) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i \times_U U_j), using the displayed equation describing maps from j_!\mathcal{O}_U into a module (proof lines 5281-5285).
Conclude exactness of the original sequence from the exactness of the Hom sequences for every \mathcal{F} via Homology's exactness-checking lemma (proof lines 5286-5288).
proof_roadmap: Turn the sequence around by applying Hom into an arbitrary module.
Recognize the resulting exact sequence as the sheaf condition for U.
Invoke the Homology criterion to transfer exactness back to the presented sequence.
difficulty_reason: The proof transfers exactness contravariantly: for any \mathcal{O}-module \mathcal{F}, applying \Hom_\mathcal{O}(-, \mathcal{F}) turns the presented sequence into the exact sequence 0 \to \mathcal{F}(U) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i) \to \prod \mathcal{F}(U_i \times_U U_j), whose exactness is the sheaf condition recorded in the chapter's displayed equation for maps out of j_!\mathcal{O}_U; the general exactness criterion from Homology then reverses the transfer. The contravariant Hom argument is the substance.
